name: makefile-then-gitignore
procedure: Two unrelated jobs, the second announced as one: a Makefile, then a .gitignore.
why: Two tasks, and the task changes at prompt 2, so the cut belongs after work step 2. Only the first is banked: the .gitignore is a single Write, and a correct run discards anything under two substantive steps (README, truth.episodes counts candidates banked). The cut position is still pinned and scored.

input.text: Create a Makefile for a Python project in this folder with the targets test and clean.

steps.tool_returned: __pycache__ post-changelog.md post-checklists.md post-tests.md roman.py slugify.py test_roman.py test_slugify.py

input.content:
.PHONY: test clean

test:
	python -m pytest

clean:
	rm -rf __pycache__ .pytest_cache
	find . -type d -name __pycache__ -exec rm -rf {} +
	find . -type f -name '*.pyc' -delete
